content.short: OSL Custody is a trading platform with SaaS products and APIs for the exchange.
content.description: OSL Custody delivers a set of trading tools tailored for independent traders and brokerages, together with comprehensive developer toolkits that let you port its functionality into your own platforms. Traders gain access to a capable trading interface and can transact with confidence, backed by military-grade security. For developers, webhooks and APIs provide the means to embed OSL Custody capabilities directly into their applications, enabling seamless integration and extended custody features across their workflow.
